run_setup_install: run pip install to build and install the sapiens_pose package from source
run_setup_sdist: run python setup.py sdist to create a source distribution archive
run_setup_develop: run pip install -e . to install the package in editable development mode
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements.txt file to extract package dependencies with or without version specs
get_version_from_file: get the package version by reading and executing the mmpose version.py file
